mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 6 months predicts positive 20-day forward returns due to easing monetary policy lowering discount rates on equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20d returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls surge above 143,000 triggers positive 20-day forward returns as strong labor demand boosts corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 143,000, or in periods of high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE signals conflicting trends but compresses discount rates and boosts confidence, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite the joint movement of FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained GDP growth above 19,000 (Chained 2017 Dollars) predicts positive 60-day forward returns as corporate earnings and consumer spending expand.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 19000, or in non-expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive 60-day forward returns due to policy accommodation easing financial constraints.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when FEDFUNDS decline occurs outside late-cycle periods, or IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP demand and industrial production supply signals robust economic expansion, driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or IC <0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers positive 20-day forward returns as low unemployment boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or in high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery, a decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive 5-day forward returns as policy accommodation stabilizes markets and lowers discount rates.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when FEDFUNDS decline occurs outside post-shock periods, or IC <0.03 over 6-month window.
